groups.defect: EventManager reads `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining, so it throws a TypeError when destinationCalendar is empty or null.
groups.rationale: All five point at the same line in EventManager and describe the same missing guard, with the same fix.

groups.defect: In GoogleCalendarService updateEvent and deleteEvent, the fallback `find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy, so it never matches and the destination-calendar fallback is lost.
groups.rationale: The same broken copy-pasted fallback appears in both updateEvent and deleteEvent. Each location needs its own edit, but one change of approach fixes both.

groups.defect: Video (non-calendar) references now get credentialId undefined instead of result.credentialId, so the video credential is lost.
groups.rationale: Both flag the same line, which drops credentialId from video references.

groups.defect: evt.destinationCalendar can be null, so `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` does nothing and collective team members' calendars are silently dropped.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same no-op push on a null array in handleNewBooking, with the same fix.
